item.title: VOICEMAILS: Part of My Life, Part of My Soul
item.description: Some moments feel big because everything’s on the line— and others only felt that way at the time. Lately our listeners have been leaving us voicemails about both: slip-ups and serious situations, fateful decisions and faux pas. Listen to hear your stories about codewords, cookies, and odd romance.Want to share your story with us? item.description: Lia Kohl & Zachary Good at Public RecordsMar. 12. 7PM. $26.78 Cellist and sound artist Lia Kohl is part of the Chicago music scene, where she does immersive musical installations, as well as genre-blurring trios with Whitney Johnson and Macie Stewart for strings, voices, and tape effects. Kohl’s solo albums often employ layers of cello, field recordings, and found sound. Voices recorded off the radio are a particularly evocative part of some of her works. item.description: Steve Earle at Gramercy Theatre Mar. 13 | 7:00 PM | $64+up When it comes to writing songs about the state of our country, few musicians can match Steve Earle. item.title: Sérgio & Odair Assad at 92NY
item.description: Sérgio & Odair Assad at 92NYMar. 14. 7:30PM. $45+up In the 1980s, the Brazilian guitar duo of Sérgio & Odair Assad released an album of music by Argentine tango composer Astor Piazzolla. Within a few years, the Assad Brothers were the most sought-after guitar duo in the world. They’ve won Grammys, played with leading classical musicians like Yo-Yo Ma, and greatly expanded the repertoire for two guitars. Now, Sérgio & Odair Assad are bidding farewell, with their final concert on Saturday, March 1
